name: core-iac
description: The claude.ai Project of core-iac (team-automation-calculator/core-iac): ad hoc cloud sessions for the repo are started in it, and any future routine spec names its id in hearth_channel_id. Created by hand in the claude.ai UI, named after the repo; the id read off the Project's URL.
notes: One Project per repo, named after it. A second Project for the same repo, or a Project named differently, is drift: rename or remove it in the UI, never adjust the spec to match.
